title: Adaptive COVID-19 Treatment Trial
brief_summary: This study evaluated antiviral therapy for adults hospitalized with COVID-19 and evidence of lower respiratory tract involvement.
eligibility_criteria: Adults 18 years and older with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and clinical evidence of respiratory disease were considered. Exclusion criteria included severe liver disease and other safety concerns.
sponsor: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases

title: A Study of Immunotherapy for Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
brief_summary: This trial studies an immunotherapy-based regimen for patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
eligibility_criteria: Participants generally need confirmed advanced non-small cell lung cancer, measurable disease, and adequate organ function. Prior treatment history and biomarker status may affect eligibility.
locations: New York, New York, United States

title: Digital Coaching and Lifestyle Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: This study evaluates whether a digital coaching program can improve glucose control and support sustainable lifestyle changes in adults with type 2 diabetes.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with type 2 diabetes who can use a smartphone may be eligible. Individuals with unstable medical conditions or inability to participate in remote coaching may be excluded.

title: Remote Monitoring for Heart Failure Patients
brief_summary: This pragmatic study tests remote monitoring and care coordination workflows for patients living with heart failure.
eligibility_criteria: Participants typically have a heart failure diagnosis and recent hospitalization or elevated risk. Device access, clinical stability, and consent requirements apply.
